contests.title: Saline County — Issue 5: Library property-tax reduction

provenance.quote:
VOTE FOR OR AGAINST REDUCING THE EXISTING LIBRARY AD VALOREM TAX LEVIED FROM THE EXISTING
ONE AND SEVEN TENTHS (1.7) MILLS TO A NEW RATE OF ONE AND ONE TENTHS (1.1) MILLS ON THE DOLLAR
OF ASSESSED VALUATION OF ALL REAL AND PERSONAL PROPERTY SUBJECT TO TAXATION IN THE COUNTY
OF SALINE, ARKANSAS

measures.questionText:
VOTE FOR OR AGAINST REDUCING THE EXISTING LIBRARY AD VALOREM TAX LEVIED FROM THE EXISTING
ONE AND SEVEN TENTHS (1.7) MILLS TO A NEW RATE OF ONE AND ONE TENTHS (1.1) MILLS ON THE DOLLAR
OF ASSESSED VALUATION OF ALL REAL AND PERSONAL PROPERTY SUBJECT TO TAXATION IN THE COUNTY
OF SALINE, ARKANSAS

provenance.quote:
VOTE FOR OR AGAINST REDUCING THE EXISTING LIBRARY AD VALOREM TAX LEVIED FROM THE EXISTING
ONE AND SEVEN TENTHS (1.7) MILLS TO A NEW RATE OF ONE AND ONE TENTHS (1.1) MILLS ON THE DOLLAR
OF ASSESSED VALUATION OF ALL REAL AND PERSONAL PROPERTY SUBJECT TO TAXATION IN THE COUNTY
OF SALINE, ARKANSAS

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Reduces the county library property-tax rate from 1.7 mills to 1.1 mills on assessed real and personal property. A mill is $1 of tax per $1,000 of assessed value.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Reduce the library property-tax rate to 1.1 mills.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve this proposed tax-rate reduction.

sources.publisher: Sebastian County Board of Election Commissioners
sources.reviewedEvidence: Notice of Election, General Election, Tuesday November 3, 2026, revised 9-28-26; pages 3–4 list federal, state and county candidates and party labels. All 18 requested-scope contests and all 33 candidates in those contests were converted from the official scanned list by OCR script and checked against its rendered pages.

sources.publisher: Arkansas State Board of Election Commissioners
sources.reviewedEvidence: Page 43: ballot-draw names come from counties and the SOS’s certified candidate list. Page 87: the CBEC publishes ballot information including candidates and measures and uploads SAMPLE ballots, due October 14, 2026 for the general election.

sources.publisher: Arkansas State Board of Election Commissioners
sources.reviewedEvidence: Offices up for election and district composition: one U.S. Senate seat, all four U.S. House districts, seven state constitutional offices, 17 listed state Senate districts, all 100 state House districts.

sources.publisher: Sebastian County Board of Election Commissioners
sources.reviewedEvidence: Individual official November 3, 2026 ballot for precinct 9F127.1 prints State Representative Ryan A. Rose, while the county notice lists State Representative Ryan Rose.

sources.publisher: Benton County Election Commission
sources.reviewedEvidence: Saved official six-page November 3, 2026 Benton County composite sample ballot. scripts/ba01-south-benton.py replays all included names, parties, offices and verbatim local measure language against the saved PDF text. Ward, school and special-district races require their own boundary mapping and remain unacquired.

sources.publisher: Pulaski County Board of Election Commissioners
sources.reviewedEvidence: Saved official five-page November 3, 2026 Pulaski County Notice of Election. scripts/ba01-south-pulaski.py replays every included candidate, printed party abbreviation and complete Jacksonville measure text. Unopposed non-mayor municipal offices and county offices except Circuit Clerk are not treated as printed ballot contests; ward and township races need exact boundaries.

<!-- flag status modal -->
<div style="display: none;" id="fsModal" class="fs-modal">
  <div class="fs-modal-content">
  <div class="fs_modal_header">
    <h1><span id="flag-status-type"></span> Flag Status</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="content">
      <h2 id="flag-status-subject" class=""></h2>
      <span id="flag-status-content"></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  /// Flag Status popup
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const usBtn = document.getElementById("us-status-container");
    const arBtn = document.getElementById("ar-status-container");
    var body = document.getElementsByTagName("body")[0];
    // Get the modal
    var modal = document.getElementById("fsModal");
    var modalType = document.getElementById("flag-status-type");
    var modalSubject = document.getElementById("flag-status-subject");
    var modalBody = document.getElementById("flag-status-content");

    var ar_flag_status_response = false;
    function closeModal() {
      body.style.overflow = 'scroll';
      modal.style.display = "none";
    }
    function openModal() {
      body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      modal.style.display = "block";
    }
    getFlagStatus = function(){
        fetch('https://flag-status.ark.org/api/status/current')
          .then(response =>{
            if (response.ok) {
              return response.json()
            }
            return Promise.reject({
                status: response.status,
                statusText: response.statusText
              })
          })
          .then(data => {
            ar_flag_status_response = data;
            document.getElementById("us-status").innerText = ar_flag_status_response.us;
            document.getElementById("ar-status").innerText = ar_flag_status_response.ar;
            // Set css & click event if there is a message to display.
            if(ar_flag_status_response.us_notification){

              /// If US message is set assign the us message to both buttons.
              usBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";

              usBtn.onclick = function(event) {
                modalType.innerText = 'US';
                modalSubject.innerText = ar_flag_status_response.us_notification.subject;
                modalBody.innerHTML = ar_flag_status_response.us_notification.body;
                openModal();
              }


              arBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";
              arBtn.onclick = function(event) {

                modalType.innerText = 'AR';
                modalSubject.innerText = ar_flag_status_response.us_notification.subject;
                modalBody.innerHTML = ar_flag_status_response.us_notification.body;
                openModal();
              }

            }
            /// if the us notification is not set and the AR notification is set.
            if(!ar_flag_status_response.us_notification && ar_flag_status_response.ar_notification){
              arBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";
              arBtn.onclick = function(event) {
                modalType.innerText = 'AR';
                modalSubject.innerText = ar_flag_status_response.ar_notification.subject;
                modalBody.innerHTML = ar_flag_status_response.ar_notification.body;
                openModal();
              }
            }
          })
          .catch(error => {
            // if there is an error, don't advertise it.
          });
      }

      document.addEventListener("click",
        function(event) {
          // If a user clicks outside the modal 'window', then close modal by calling closeModal()
          if (
            !event.target.closest(".fs-modal-content")
          ) {
            closeModal()
          }
        },
        true
      )

      // Call the API.
      getFlagStatus();
    });
</script>
